action: The five finish a playful gentle sway in their loose arc, tiny limbs moving naturally; @Mochi notices a distant golden glimmer above screen-left and lifts its face. The others follow the same eyeline without changing places.
camera: Wide, 35mm equivalent, fixed plush-eye-level camera; enough depth of field for all five.
audio: Soft grass footsteps, faint breeze, a quiet celesta and pizzicato phrase. No voices.
end_state: All five look up toward the arriving point.

action: @Star drifts slowly down diagonally from upper-left to the moss hollow, its five-point form becoming visible. It settles softly into the hollow with one gentle bounce and remains dim. No impact, crater, dust burst or distress.
camera: Hard cut to a low medium-wide 50mm view of the hollow; small downward tilt follows only the last part of descent.
audio: One delicate descending bell shimmer, soft felt landing.
end_state: One dim star lies safely in the moss hollow.

action: @Mochi takes two small steps and kneels beside the hollow, lowering its face toward @Star with a caring tilt. The other four watch in the background in their established order. Hold the affectionate discovery for the last second.
camera: Hard cut to medium 65mm; @Mochi and the hollow sharp, the four friends softly readable behind.
audio: Felt footsteps and a tiny breathy nonverbal wonder sound without syllables.
end_state: @Mochi kneels beside the dim star; the others remain close.
